mapper.select: SELECT C.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN , C.PST_SN , C.CTPT_MBR_SN , C.CHAT_ROOM_STTS_CD , C.REG_DT , C.MDFCN_DT FROM OTO_CHAT_ROOM C WHERE C.PST_SN = #{pstSn} AND C.CTPT_MBR_SN = #{ctptMbrSn}
SELECT C.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN , C.PST_SN , C.CTPT_MBR_SN , C.CHAT_ROOM_STTS_CD , C.REG_DT , C.MDFCN_DT FROM OTO_CHAT_ROOM C WHERE C.PST_SN = #{pstSn} AND C.CTPT_MBR_SN = #{ctptMbrSn} FOR SHARE
mapper.sql: SELECT C.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN , C.PST_SN , C.CTPT_MBR_SN , C.CHAT_ROOM_STTS_CD , C.REG_DT , C.MDFCN_DT , P.PST_TTL , P.PST_STTS_CD , P.MBR_SN AS OWNER_MBR_SN , AS OWNER_NCNM , AS OWNER_ATCH_FILE_SN , AS APPLICANT_NCNM , AS APPLICANT_ATCH_FILE_SN , R.PET_PRTC_RCRT_SN , R.RCRT_STTS_CD , T.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN , T.MTCH_DLNG_STTS_CD FROM OTO_CHAT_ROOM C JOIN PST P ON P.PST_SN = C.PST_SN JOIN PET_PRTC_RCRT R ON R.PST_SN = C.PST_SN JOIN MBR O ON O.MBR_SN = P.MBR_SN JOIN MBR A ON A.MBR_SN = C.CTPT_MBR_SN LEFT JOIN PET_PRTC_MTCH T ON T.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN = C.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN WHERE C.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN = #{otoChatRoomSn}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OTO_CHAT_ROOM ( PST_SN , CTPT_MBR_SN , CHAT_ROOM_STTS_CD , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{pstSn} , #{ctptMbrSn} , #{chatRoomSttsCd} , NOW() , NOW() )
INSERT INTO CHAT_PRTPNT ( OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN , MBR_SN , PTCP_STTS_CD , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{otoChatRoomSn} , #{mbrSn} , #{ptcpSttsCd} , NOW() , NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT C.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN , C.PST_SN , C.CTPT_MBR_SN , C.CHAT_ROOM_STTS_CD , C.REG_DT , C.MDFCN_DT FROM OTO_CHAT_ROOM C WHERE C.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN = #{otoChatRoomSn} FOR UPDATE

SELECT T.CHAT_PRTPNT_SN , T.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN , T.MBR_SN , T.PTCP_STTS_CD , T.LAST_PRSL_MSG_SEQ , T.REG_DT , T.MDFCN_DT FROM CHAT_PRTPNT T WHERE T.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN = #{otoChatRoomSn} AND T.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn}
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_PRTPNT SET LAST_PRSL_MSG_SEQ = LEAST(#{lastPrslMsgSeq}, ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(M.MSG_SEQ), 0) FROM CHAT_MSG M WHERE M.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN = #{otoChatRoomSn} )) , LAST_PRSL_DT = NOW() , MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN = #{otoChatRoomSn} AND MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND LAST_PRSL_MSG_SEQ < LEAST(#{lastPrslMsgSeq}, ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(M3.MSG_SEQ), 0) FROM CHAT_MSG M3 WHERE M3.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN = #{otoChatRoomSn} ))
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_MSG_PHOTO PH JOIN CHAT_MSG M ON M.CHAT_MSG_SN = PH.CHAT_MSG_SN WHERE M.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN = #{otoChatRoomSn} AND PH.ATCH_FILE_SN = #{atchFileSn} )
